desc: Sensors measure soil and detergent levels throughout the cycle and during the rinse to optimize wash and rinse times, deliver better fabric care and ensure a thorough clean.Adaptive Smarter Wash Technology enables greater optimization of cleaning power and fabric care within each cycle.43 7/8 H x 27 7/8 W x 28 D
hl: Save time and effort with a dispenser that holds enough detergent for up to 32 loads.

In the SmartHQ App, you can input voice or text commands based off the type of fabric and stains you are washing and SmartHQ Assistant will give you expert recommendations and automatically set your machine for optimal results
Clean even the most heavily soiled items with a single cycle that adds detergent, agitates, soaks, drains the dirty water and repeats the wash process with clean water and fresh detergent
Antimicrobial protection is built into key washer components to help prevent the growth of odor-causing bacteria in areas like the tub cover, dispenser drawer and drain hose
The direct drive motor and patented Dynamic Balancing Technology minimizes uneven loads and provides a quieter wash
Intelligent technology adapts the wash action to minimize tangled loads
